description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order made to amend the Schedule II of the Order published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1992/29 of 10.11.2016 by inserting item No. 5 which is relevant to Motor Vehicles
reasoning: This gazette contains an order made under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989, which amends a schedule to modify excise duty regulations for specific motor vehicles. The content involves a regulatory amendment to existing legislation, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover "legal amendments, repeals, or modifications" and "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation." While a minister is named, this is incidental to the primary purpose of publishing a legal/regulatory change, not a personnel appointment or portfolio assignment.
